# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old (at the end of Volume 1)  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is a big, fat, stolid youth with a round, expressionless face. He has a slim and upright figure sitting beside him when driving.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

Billy suffers from a painful lack of conversational gifts, often only grinning and chuckling without thinking of a reply until it is too late. He is extremely shy in social gatherings, preferring to wait outside with his horse team rather than join formal suppers. Despite his quiet nature, he holds immense admiration for Anne Shirley and takes quiet pride in being near her.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_

## Traits

- Stolid and quiet  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Lack of conversational skills  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Socially shy  <sub>[v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)</sub>

## Abilities

- Driving a double-seated buggy and horse team  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)</sub>

## History

Billy Andrews is a young man living in Avonlea with his family. When a concert was held at the White Sands Hotel, Billy drove a double-seated buggy to transport his sister Jane, Anne Shirley, and Diana Barry to the venue. Insisting that Anne ride on the front seat beside him, he was puffed up with pride to drive her, though he remained mostly silent, offering only grins and chuckles to her conversation. After the performance, he decamped to wait outside with his team in mortal fear of being invited inside for supper. He successfully drove the girls back home after the event.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_
